```lean
intro h
split
· intro s a ha
  have : a ∉ s ∨ a ∈ s := Or.inl ha
  cases this with h1 h2
  · exact h s a h1
  · rw [insert_eq_self at h2]
    exact h s a h2
· intro h'
  intro s a ha
  have : a ∉ s ∨ a ∈ s := Or.inl ha
  cases this with h1 h2
  · exact h' s a h1
  · rw [insert_eq_self at h2]
    exact h' s a h2
```
